extracted.name: Pear Salad with Balsamic and Walnuts
extracted.description: This pear salad recipe is a stunning fall side dish! Simple, elegant, and delicious, it'd be a great addition to a Thanksgiving or holiday dinner.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon chopped hazelnuts (or more pecans or walnuts)
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
instruction_lines: Arrange the mixed greens on a serving platter or in a serving bowl. Top with the pears and fennel. Squeeze a little lemon juice over the pears and fennel and toss.
Top with the cranberries, pecans, walnuts, hazelnuts, and pecorino. Drizzle with balsamic vinaigrette. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
